about: The exact argv the app spawns for each carrier child, after the bundled cmux-tui. cmux-tui carrier/argv_contract_tests.rs runs each through the real carrier CLI parser (no network); CmuxNextCloudTests CloudCarrierArgvContractTests asserts CloudCarrierDial builds exactly these from `swift`. The machine id is a real one (`vm_` and 20 lowercase letters or digits), as the parser requires. Add a child here when the app spawns a new one (next: `carrier key --public`).
